name: marker
useFor: Use between messages or rows to mark time (Yesterday, Oct 28), a change the agent made (Search widened to 25 mi), or where new results start (variant unread). Keep it one short line; links inside are underlined.
constraints: More than one unread marker in a list
source: Not in Figma: Mist and Forest rules from Cited fields (443:470), for a designer's review
title: Marker
description: A 12px muted note in a conversation or list: a date between Mist rules, an event with a glyph, or the Forest line where new results begin.
